title: RuntimeLocator
description: Canonical contract for runtime semantic locator resolution results in live browser contexts.

semanticTarget.description: Target canonical semantic path (e.g. applicant.fullName, contact.email).

found.description: Whether a reliable live browser element was located.

strategy.description: The strongest reliable strategy used to locate the element.

confidence.description: Confidence score of the resolved locator.

evidence.description: Trace evidence explaining which attribute, label, or relationship confirmed the match.

selector.description: Playwright selector or locator query expression.

framePath.description: Frame path identifier if located inside an iframe.

error.description: Error code if resolution failed (e.g. LOCATOR_NOT_FOUND).
